items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, of course Vic Dickinson, and of course Trummy Young, and of course Juan Tizol. All of these wonderful trombonists.

ctx.x: Well, of course Vic Dickinson, and of course Trummy Young, and of course Juan Tizol. All of these wonderful trombonists. But somehow Fred Beckett left a mark on me.
After you mentioned that in an interview with somebody, I think virtually every trombone player in the business went to try to find those records.
